paper_metadata.title: Thermal stability of Ni-based superalloys fabricated through additive manufacturing: A review
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

evidence.quote: Ni-based superalloys are regarded as potential candidates for high-temperature applications, thanks to their capability to benefit from various strengthening mechanisms such as precipitation hardening and solid solution strengthening.

Research on AM-LPBF Inconel 718 [ 50 ] indicates that the spacing between hatchings and the process of laser remelting affect microstructural features such as the direction of texture and the orientation of dendrites.
